issue: Comtrade holds first-release Kyrgyz figures: 12 of 16 months from 2025 match the first national release within 1%, none matches the latest; latest runs 9% higher at the median
research_impact: Recent months are provisional and may understate imports. The 2025 shortfall may partly be under-recording
recommended_treatment: Keep as observed, flag as provisional, take new snapshots, and evaluate on first-release data

issue: 2025 Comtrade gasoline value is 0.78 of the official value, against 0.95-1.00 in 2022-2024
recommended_treatment: Recheck when the 2025 energy balance appears

issue: Russia reports far more gasoline to Kyrgyzstan than Kyrgyzstan reports importing in 2016-2017 (import/export mass 0.33-0.37); ratio is 0.93-1.02 in 2018 and 2021
HS 271019 misses blended diesel in CZE, HUN, LSO, LUX, SVK
research_impact: Distillates are not comparable across countries
recommended_treatment: Use middle_incl_blends for these reporters or exclude them

issue: Fuels seem filed under the wrong HS line in BWA, ETH, LSO, MWI, SSD, SWZ
research_impact: Series would not mean gasoline or distillates
recommended_treatment: Exclude from the main experiment; use the 2710 total if needed

issue: Series ending before the window ends
recommended_treatment: Report the countries covering each test period

issue: Annual exporter-importer pairs differing by more than 3 times
research_impact: Bilateral flows are less reliable than country totals
recommended_treatment: Use supplier shares as indicators, not exact flows

issue: No Russian mirror data exists after December 2021
research_impact: Main supplier cannot be cross-checked in the shock period

issue: Sum of monthly World values differs from the annual submission by more than 5%
research_impact: Of 513 reporter-product-years. Annual data seem revised while monthly data are not (Kyrgyz gasoline 2021: monthly 0.87 of annual)
recommended_treatment: Note in the coverage matrix; do not rescale monthly data

issue: Six-digit lines differ from the 2710 heading by more than 1%
recommended_treatment: Use lines as reported, keep a flag

issue: Net weight and kg quantity differ by more than 1%
research_impact: Of 406099 rows holding both; concentrated in ['HUN', 'BWA', 'MNG']

issue: Net weight null or zero next to positive value
recommended_treatment: Treated as missing; kg quantity used if plausible

issue: Physically impossible kg quantity against reported litres
Weight flagged as estimated by the reporter
research_impact: Mass is partly modelled, by Comtrade or the reporter

issue: Explicit zero-trade rows
research_impact: Comtrade does not report zero flows, so a genuine zero cannot be proved

issue: Month-on-month mass change above 5 times
research_impact: Mixes real lumpy deliveries and recording errors
recommended_treatment: Keep; test robust losses; never smooth the target

issue: Mass removed: unit value far too low
Unit value far too high, mass kept
research_impact: Value suspect; lagged unit-value features affected
recommended_treatment: Flag; exclude flagged months from unit-value features

issue: Reporting interruptions inside a reporter's span
research_impact: Series have gaps, some of 10-13 months

issue: Countries with no monthly reporting at all
research_impact: Afghanistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and others cannot enter

issue: World row lacks mass although partners carry it
Exact duplicates on the natural key in raw records
research_impact: Would double count; all belong to AND
recommended_treatment: Removed in Phase 1, keeping latest retrieval; they arise from keyless and keyed pulls overlapping

issue: Partners without a country identity (Other Asia nes, Other Europe nes, Areas nes)
recommended_treatment: Keep as one partner; nes_share is reported per month

issue: Reporter listed as its own partner
recommended_treatment: Excluded from concentration, kept in the dataset

issue: Bunkers and special categories as partners
recommended_treatment: Excluded from concentration, kept in the dataset

issue: Rows filed under an HS edition at least six years old
research_impact: Lines may be defined differently from newer editions
recommended_treatment: Mapping 271011 to 271012 is safe at this level; 271020 cannot be split out under H3

issue: Breakdown between 271011 (HS2007) and 271012 (HS2012 on)
research_impact: Biodiesel-containing oils left this line in HS2012, so the merged series is not perfectly continuous; negligible for Kyrgyz data from 2015

issue: Rows with no quantity unit (N/A)
research_impact: Quantity cannot be used; net weight still can

issue: Mass from kg quantity because net weight is empty
Rows with no usable mass
recommended_treatment: Stay missing; value_share_with_mass reports the effect

issue: Robust outliers in log mass (|z| > 4)
research_impact: May be shocks, the object of study

issue: Published reporter-month with no product record
Value reported with no mass
recommended_treatment: Keep missing; never derive mass from value

issue: Months resting on World rows, without partner detail
Partner sum and World value differ by more than 5%
research_impact: Would signal double counting or lost partners

issue: Mislabelled official figure: 2025 diesel in NSC table 4.03.00.12 reads USD 48.1 billion
research_impact: An official source can also be wrong
recommended_treatment: Excluded from ratios, kept in raw

issue: Duplicates left in the research datasets
Comtrade reporter identifiers that disagree with config/countries.csv
Periods that disagree with refYear and refMonth
HS codes that do not exist in the stated edition
Positive quantities in a unit other than kg
research_impact: Must not be mixed with mass

issue: Negative quantities or values
Missing trade value
